grader: measure-only: ran_rl.operate (RAN RL SDK 1.2.9, organisers' code, `make operate`) plays one 5-step episode of the PPO policy on the team's Viavi RSG twin; record_viavi_operate.py (team13 wrapper, scratch, not yet committed) turns reports/operate.json into one item per step (requested action, action after the SDK safety filter, rules fired, objective, KPIs) and counts the steps; no KPI gate

config.aws: no AWS job and no AWS-written log: check_unit part c has no AWS window for this run (expected CANNOT CHECK, not a pass); region is the team's default, required by the schema
config.items_rule: one item per entry of reports/operate.json steps[]; item_id step-<n>; value = number of items; passed iff value == 5

model.alias: same artifact as ppo-cco-reward-v1-ckpt50k in t1.rl.eval-20261103T043115Z-bf52

config.purpose: Track 1 RL stage 6 (operate): the served PPO policy acts on the Viavi RSG, a stand-in for a production network it was never trained on (trained and scored on Maveric)
config.route: team's signed-in browser session: local MCP relay (same-origin fetch to the RSG's /mcp in the Viavi app tab) -> organisers' adapter (python -m ran_rl_host.adapter.serve --backend viavi_rsg) on the team's Mac -> make operate (RAN_RL_VIAVI_TWIN_URL). RSG host, URL, IPs, cookies and tokens are not recorded
config.scenario_file: twin-source/config/viavi_scenarios/maveric_4cell.json (organisers' twin-host source 1.2.9; saved on the RSG by make create-viavi-scenario); its sha256 is test_set_sha256

twin.version: Viavi RSG ai-rsg 1.0 via ran_rl_host viavi_rsg adapter (SDK 1.2.9)
